interference.description: overlap between any two placed parts
interference.title: Interference

clearance.description: minimum (and maximum) distance between two parts
clearance.title: Clearance

sections.description: section views, one file each (own renderer)
sections.title: Sections

sheet.description: full annotated drawing sheet via draftwright
sheet.title: Sheet

page.description: sheet size, e.g. "A4", "A3"; automatic if omitted
page.title: Page

convex.description: true: outer corners, false: inner corners
convex.title: Convex

of.description: feature id: faces created or modified by it
of.title: Of

nth.description: index after sorting along sort_by (or the normal axis)
nth.title: Nth

near.description: the single face whose centre is closest
near.title: Near

fit.description: hole size for a standard thread
fit.title: Fit

centered.description: centre the row on the shape (true) or start at it (false)
centered.title: Centered

sections.description: one closed shape per section, each on its own plane
sections.title: Sections

Mate.description: One relationship between a face of the placed part and a face of something already placed.

type.description: against: flat faces touch, normals opposed; flush: coplanar, same normal; coaxial: cylinder/cone/hole axes coincide; parallel: normals aligned, no move
type.title: Type

this.description: face of the placed part, selected in its own coordinates
this.title: This

to.description: an earlier placed part's name, the assembly name for its own features, or a datum: XY, XZ, YZ (planes) X, Y, Z (axes)
to.title: To

face.description: face of the target part (not for datums)
face.title: Face

offset.description: against/flush: gap along the target normal
offset.title: Offset

angle.description: coaxial: turn about the axis after mating, degrees
angle.title: Angle

flip.description: reverse the direction the mate would pick
flip.title: Flip

Mate.title: Mate

features.description: feature ids to mirror; omit to mirror the whole body
features.title: Features

origin.description: optional sketch-origin shift [u, v] on the plane
origin.title: Origin

OpenPath.description: An open 2D path on a plane, used as a sweep path.
OpenPath.title: OpenPath

file.description: another cadjson part file, relative to this file
file.title: File

rotate.description: degrees about X, Y, Z applied before translation
rotate.title: Rotate

Placement.description: A part positioned in an assembly.

name.description: defaults to the file's part name
name.title: Name

at.description: position; what the mates leave free keeps this
at.title: At

rotate.description: degrees about X, Y, Z, applied before at and before mates
rotate.title: Rotate

mates.description: applied in order; each fixes some of the six degrees of freedom
mates.title: Mates

Placement.title: Placement

rotate.description: rotate each instance with its angle
rotate.title: Rotate

name.description: label; defaults to A, B, C ...
name.title: Name

flip.description: keep the other half and look from the other side
flip.title: Flip

profile.description: closed profile on a plane at the path start, perpendicular to it

size.description: font size (cap height-ish) in document units
size.title: Size

font_path.description: a .ttf/.otf file, relative to the part file; overrides font
font_path.title: Font Path

face.description: the cylindrical face to thread (a shank or a hole wall)
face.title: Face

length.description: threaded length; whole face if omitted
length.title: Length

near.description: thread starts at the face end nearest this point
near.title: Near

$schema.description: optional editor hint pointing at the JSON Schema file
$schema.title: $Schema

extends.description: base part file (relative): inherit its params and features; this file's params override, features with a known id replace, new ids append
extends.title: Extends

drop.description: with extends: ids of base features to leave out
drop.title: Drop

parts.description: assembly: other part files placed in this one
parts.title: Parts

checks.description: assembly fit checks; interference is checked by default
